text:
mira (eng-sre): Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's GPU shortage — listing proposed action items and owners. Can owners ack and set ETA? TL;DR: recurring spikes around 22:00, autoscaler lag, headroom too tight.

dan (eng-platform): Ack. I'll own scheduler tuning. Plan: increase preemption buffer & reduce scale-up cooldown. Target deploy 2026-04-02. :thumbsup:

zoe (ml-infra): Ack. I'll file the quota bump request for us-west-2 GPUs today. ETA for request creation: 2026-03-26. Approval usually 5-7 biz days.

tom (oncall): Observed pattern: nightly batch retrains + user traffic spike => sustained token throughput that saturates pod slots. Suggest request-level circuit breaker for long-running jobs.

mira (eng-sre): Added circuit-breaker task to backlog. @dan can you add an autoscale integration test in staging to validate cooldowns and headroom?

dan (eng-platform): Yep. I'll create a synthetic load job (k6 + token generator) and schedule runs: 2026-03-28 and 2026-04-01. Will post run links/logs.

zoe (ml-infra): For the quota request please use these numbers: current baseline 40 GPUs -> requested 80 GPUs; peak headroom target 30%. I'll draft the PR with supporting telemetry.

anna (product): Noted. If quota approval slips, product will prepare a throttling plan for non-critical batch jobs and a customer comms note. Target draft 2026-03-27.

mira (eng-sre): Action items (short):
1) Scheduler tuning - dan - target 2026-04-02
2) Quota request - zoe - create 2026-03-26
3) Autoscale test (staging) - dan - 03/28 & 04/01
4) Circuit breaker implementation - mira - target 2026-03-30
5) Product comms + throttling plan - anna - 2026-03-27

tom (oncall): Suggest moving circuit-breaker target up to 2026-03-30 (earlier) — confirms. :eyes:

mira (eng-sre): OK moved circuit-breaker to 2026-03-30. Updated above.

incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-83 closed; follow-ups added to tracker: https://redwood.internal/tasks/INC-2026-83

dan (eng-platform): FYI config snippet I'll start with in testing:
```
scaleUpCooldown: 30s
scaleDownCooldown: 120s
minHeadroomPct: 30
preemptionBuffer: 0.12
```
I'll iterate based on synthetic runs.

zoe (ml-infra): I'll attach the quota PR and include the telemetry plots. Note: coordinate with Dedicated customers for on-prem pool carryover if approval is delayed.

mira (eng-sre): Thanks all — please update the task tracker when you flip statuses. Will follow up in 48h with a quick sync if we have blockers. :thumbsup:
